name: Quizlet
summary: A light learning-product style with Chalk Canvas page background, Paper White cards, Ink Charcoal text, Iris Bolt as the single saturated accent, Hurme-style geometric typography, 200px pill buttons, 8px content cards, 24px pastel feature cards, compact spacing, and product-first flashcard imagery.

typography.style: single-family geometric sans system for friendly learning UI

layout.model: centered learning-product page with compact white cards on gray canvas, pill search, horizontal feature carousel, alternating white/lilac product sections, and footer link grid

elevation.rule: Use one subtle shadow token; do not stack elevation.

dos: Use Iris Bolt exclusively for filled interactive elements, links, and active states.
Apply 200px radius to all primary filled buttons.
Set body text in Ink Charcoal at weight 400.
Use 8px radius on content cards and 24px only on hero feature category cards.
Build white card surfaces over the Chalk Canvas page background.
Use 80px section gaps, 24px larger card padding, and 8px element gaps.
Apply the single subtle shadow token to nav bars and elevated cards only.
donts: Do not introduce additional saturated colors beyond Iris Bolt.
Do not use 4px or 8px radius on primary filled buttons.
Do not set headings to weight 700 by default.
Do not use pure black for normal body text.
Do not place cards directly on Lilac Wash without an inner white panel.
Do not apply heavy or multi-layer shadows.
Do not use Mist Border as a fill color.
